From: Sophie Martin <procurement@nimblebank.com>

Date: Sun, 03 Jan 2027 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted baseline -> Dedicated/Private cost crosswalk request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at NimbleBank was impressed with the latency profiles and routing features. Procurement and Finance have a follow-up ask for us: they want a concise crosswalk that shows how Redwood's hosted baseline pricing translates to Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) and Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments. Specifically they want: 

- Per-token baseline for hosted (generation + embeddings) we can use for benchmarking
- How unit economics change for Dedicated (committed monthly/annual) including typical reservation tiers and burst options
- Incremental costs associated with Private (VPC egress, KMS/HSM integrations, license/platform fees) and an example amortized per-10M-token rate
- Typical discount ranges for committed volume / multi-year contracts and any enterprise add-on fees (observability retention, compliance pack)

Can you share a short summary + a spreadsheet with assumptions and example math? We need something to circulate with Finance and Legal tomorrow morning (PST). 

Also include any constraints (minimum commitments, lead times for Dedicated capacity, and on-prem support windows). If it's helpful, CC our legal contact (legal@nimblebank.com).

Appreciate it — Sophie
Sophie Martin
Head of Procurement, NimbleBank

--

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear ask and the timing note.

We can absolutely produce a concise crosswalk and a worked spreadsheet. To make the math match your expected workload, two quick clarifications would help: 

1) Expected monthly token mix (ratio of short-chat generation tokens vs long-form generation vs embeddings) — if unknown, we'll present two scenarios: chat-heavy and embedding-heavy.
2) Desired commitment horizon for Dedicated pricing (monthly reserved vs annual commit) and whether NimbleBank requires burstable capacity beyond the reserved pool.

Assumptions we'll include: 
- Hosted baseline: list prices per 1k tokens (generation) and per embedding unit, plus typical percent overhead for streaming/connection.
- Dedicated: amortized GPU cost per token using three reservation tiers (small, mid, large) with a utilization band (70-90%) and explicit unit calculations for autoscaling/burst allowance.
- Private: one-time platform fee, monthly ops license, plus per-region networking and KMS charges; we'll show a sample amortization across a 12-month term and per-10M-token equivalent.

I'm attaching a first-pass workbook (Redwood_pricing_crosswalk_v1.xlsx) and a short summary PDF. Ben and Laura are looped in for discounts and contractual notes. If you can confirm the two items above, we'll finalize and get it back to you before EOD your time tomorrow.

Thanks,

Sooj
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Hi Sophie — thanks for the patience. Attached is a concise summary and the workbook with the cell-level assumptions (Redwood_pricing_crosswalk_v1.xlsx). High-level takeaways below so Finance can circulate quickly: 

Summary (top-line)
- Hosted baseline (public): use $0.0032 / 1k tokens for chat-default and $0.0044 / 1k tokens for long-form as conservative baselines. Embeddings at $0.0009 / unit.
- Dedicated (reserved): depending on reservation tier and utilization, per-token unit cost typically ranges $0.0010 - $0.0020. The spreadsheet includes three modeled tiers (small/mid/large) and an explicit cell for burst buffer economics.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): expect one-time integration/platform fees and a monthly ops/license charge which materially affects per-token when volume is low. Example amortized range per 10M tokens: $0.0008 - $0.0035.
- Discounts: standard bands we typically offer are 5-10% (12mo mid), 15-30% (multi-year enterprise with committed throughput and compliance add-ons). Specific discount eligibility will depend on total committed spend and procurement/credit checks.

Constraints / operational notes
- Dedicated lead time: 2-6 weeks to provision reserved pools depending on region and tier; burst capacity is available within 24-72 hours if not already reserved.
- Minimums: small-tier reserved pools require 30-day commit; mid/large 90-day; Private on-prem engagements require a signed SOW and an initial platform fee.
- Compliance add-ons: SOC 2 attestation included; additional evidence (HSM integrations, enhanced logging retention) priced as add-ons in the workbook.

Next steps
1) If you confirm a target monthly token mix (chat vs. long-form vs. embeddings) we will populate the two scenario tabs with your numbers.
2) If NimbleBank has a target commitment horizon (12/24/36 months) tell us and we'll produce a committed-pricing model with the discount bands applied.
3) If helpful, we can present this live in a 30-minute walkthrough with Ben and Laura tomorrow PST.

Thanks — attaching again the workbook + SOW stub.

Best,

Sooj
